definitions.explanation: Being of the same sex or gender. Used in social, legal, and relationship contexts.

examples.japanese: {同性|どうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I have many friends of the same sex.

examples.japanese: {同性|どうせい}{婚|こん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of countries recognizing same-sex marriage is increasing.

examples.japanese: {同性|どうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧な⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Calls for equal rights for same-sex couples are growing.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently used as a modifier ({同性|どうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) or in compounds like {同性婚|どうせいこん} (same-sex marriage) and ⟦{同性愛|どうせいあい}→同性愛：23993_douseiai⟧ (homosexuality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同性婚|どうせいこん} (same-sex marriage)
- ⟦{同性愛|どうせいあい}→同性愛：23993_douseiai⟧ (homosexuality)
- {同性|どうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧ (friend of the same sex)
- {同性|どうせい}⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧ (same-sex couple)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異性|いせい}→異性：13568_isei⟧: opposite sex — the antonym
- ⟦{同棲|どうせい}→同棲：11903_dousei⟧: cohabitation, living together — a homophone with completely different meaning and kanji
- ⟦{両性|りょうせい}→両性：18569_ryousei⟧: both sexes
